test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ramesh does half as much work as Parul in 4/5 of the time. If together Ramesh and Parul take 24 days to complete the work, then how much time will Parul take to do it?
solution:
**Given:**

Ramesh does half as much work as Parul in 4/5 of the time.

**Calculation:**

Let, Parul, take x days to complete the work

Ramesh does half as much work as Parul in 4/5 of the time

Number of days Ramesh takes to do the work

⇒ 2 × 4x/5 

⇒ 8x/5

Together they can complete the work in 24 days

⇒ 1/x + 5/8x = 1/24

⇒ 13/8x = 1/24

⇒ x = 39 days

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
